entities.summary: Janalynn Castelino is a multilingual pop singer, songwriter, record producer and medical doctor. She made her international crossover debut in 2024, with the Spanish-language single "Drama". Her music has been described as pop with R&B elements. Castelino has recorded in many languages including English, Latin, Italian, Spanish and Hindi.
